in_marathi.name: Ginansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledge, Wisdom, Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ginansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ginansh is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Gyan' meaning 'knowledge' or 'wisdom' and 'Ish' meaning 'God' or 'victory'. This name signifies the attainment of divine knowledge and victory over challenges. It is a name that symbolizes wisdom and strength.
